items.title: Cascadu interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: I was able to do two sessions with Jon Hendricks

ctx.x: when I was finished with that, and it almost took me out, I was really sick and everything, you know I called Jimmy and I said, “Jimmy,” ‘cause I always stayed in touch with Jimmy throughout the years. And I said, “Jimmy, I’m finished man. I’m tired of this thing. I’m not well you know, the school has taken me out, it’s going to take me a while to recover and everything else.” And Jimmy says, “Come in. Come let’s go play music.” And he put me on the bandstand right away. And I think that part of that is that…

That was extremely eloquent, and I’m — I had eighteen questions to ask you, so this means you have to come back to Hamilton College for part two of our interview. I mean I just am fascinated just to listen to you talk and I’m reminded of I was able to do two sessions with Jon Hendricks and he has the same positive — he had the same positive vibe that you do, and I most appreciate you making me feel better today.
Let that spirituality be praised. That’s a gift that we share.
